scenery.notes: Campus landmarks based on institutional architectural sources. Layouts, surface treatments and props are reconstructed. Conventional Canvas geometry is rasterized to reusable scenery sprites; students, animals and period traffic are animated by code.

portraits.format: Identified photographs with deterministic posterization and edge filtering
portraits.animation: Manually positioned mouth and eye landmarks, small source-patch warps and conventional 2D motion. Captioned teaching dialogue is fictional; no recorded or cloned researcher voice.

weather.format: Deterministic Canvas light, haze, rain, leaves and sparse flurries
weather.context: Designed representative autumn ambience, not observed historical or live weather

campusToys.format: Original source-coded toy mechanisms and conventional Canvas drawings
campusToys.context: Optional fictional campus installations; they do not provide research evidence or campaign credit

music.performers: Czech National Symphony Orchestra / Musopen Symphony Orchestra
